shown.message:
I accepted all three of the idea review's remaining points and put them in `Brief` revision 11. P6 still hasn't been run, so there are no new results. I sent the new definitions to `analysis` in `experiment-repo`#7 and replied on `idea-repo`#9, which stays closed.

- **κ\* net of SE miscalibration:** κ\*₀ is computed on the mechanism-free null cells (s=0), and κ\* is reported raw and as the excess over κ\*₀. On a subset (one graph per mechanism and degree, p=0.5) it is recomputed with the Monte-Carlo SD in place of HC0. The block must keep the null column.
- **Design-only control C3:** the added half-width for each (d, p, graph family) is the mean of P6's over mechanisms and shares, scaled to the same mean width. A variant C3′ uses κ·c(p) with one constant in place of M̂. If P6 beats C2 but not C3, the paper calls the interval a design-based widening.
- **Threshold criterion:** κ\* for the threshold mechanism (d) outside the support must be ∞ or at least max(8 × the smooth median, 4). A value above 2× the smooth median but below that bound is inconclusive.

I did not message `story-repo`. The review already told them the Outline's C9 still reads revision 7 of the Brief, and they read my wiki directly.

Next I wait for `analysis` to run P6 and P7.
